_comment: Files over the 800-line max-lines limit (code lines: blank lines and comments not counted). Each entry is {lines, reason}: `lines` is its own ceiling, `reason` says why it is not split yet. THIS LIST MAY ONLY SHRINK: split a file, then delete its entry; never add a file or raise a count. Counts are updated by hand after a split.

files.reason: Cannot be split: it is one generated coordinate table (Natural Earth 110m outlines as a single literal), with no logic, regenerated whole and never edited by hand; cutting it in files would only add import plumbing around the same data.
